name: Crowley JAXPORT Terminal Office #3 - Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.siteIdentification: 3001 Talleyrand Ave = Crowley Port Office #3. The roster point sits essentially ON the modernized north-gate canopy of the Talleyrand terminal. Idx 1 (2831), idx 3 (3001) and idx 4 (2085) are three Crowley offices on the SAME physical Talleyrand terminal complex; idx 3 is the gate/office at the north end. Audited as the northern terminal section centered on the gate.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed at satellite z20: a multi-lane covered gate canopy with yellow lane chevrons painted on the apron - the modernized 'north gate'. A check-in booth structure sits at the head of the canopy.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A booth/check-in structure is integrated at the head of the gate canopy. Staffed gate (port TWIC access).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: ~5 covered lanes under the gate canopy by the chevron count; assigned ~3 inbound / ~2 outbound. Exit-lane split low confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Multi-lane covered canopy with a wide apron - clear room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.scale: Web profile states the Talleyrand terminal has 3 scales; the modernized multi-lane gate canopy is consistent with in-lane scales. Set true but flagged uncertain (not individually resolved in imagery).
fieldNotes.multiStep: Multi-lane gated check-in plus the booth at the canopy head, with likely in-lane scaling, indicates a staged check-in process.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive container/trailer stacking yard east of the gate - hundreds of units; banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Marine terminal - minimal warehouse dock doors near the gate area; ~6 estimated, low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs serve the Talleyrand terminal complex (visible NW and along the west edge).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: gate complex, multiple offices/transit sheds, tank farm, container yards.
